summaries.summary: The Printers class is a UI page object that manages printer-related operations in the Android Smart app. It provides methods for adding printers, selecting printers from lists, verifying various printer screens (Printers, Add Printer, Printer Name, Printer Information, Printer Settings), and validating printer operations such as adding, removing, and checking printer existence. The class inherits from SmartFlow and implements comprehensive verification methods for UI elements and user workflows related to printer management.
